integrity: All-length proof uses Möbius inversion, exact character orthogonality, power domination and a strict subgroup-union bound; reproducibility checks use standalone exact arithmetic only. Independent validation not claimed.
scientific_limitations: Unweighted indicator of position-labelled full-period words on a finite abelian alphabet, n>=2. Does not concern orbit representatives, nonabelian alphabets, or weighted ensembles. Historical novelty remains subject to unindexed equivalent formulations.
title: Fourier support and sharp recovery of primitive words over finite abelian alphabets
